Name: CP Pet Bed
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This is a simple mod that adds a bed for your pet using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].

To acquire the bed, you can craft it using 10 wool and 2 cloth.

To have your pet sleep on the bed, use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10462]Custom Pet Beds[/url] mod.

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
